# Outbound HTTPS allow-list for agent jobs (founder-owned). One host name per line, matched against the TLS server name
# (SNI) by a local proxy. Exact names only (no wildcards); the lock adds this run's own OIDC host when the job has
# id-token: write.
# Keep it to exact hosts: github.com itself stays open (git push, API), so gist.github.com, uploads.github.com and others do not.
# GitHub: git and API. No release storage (objects./release-assets.githubusercontent.com) and no Azure blob names: both
# answered for other hosts in the domain-fronting test (docs/runbooks/agent-network-lock.md); the lock installs gitleaks,
# Claude Code and Bun before it closes, and the runner's log upload worked without them.
github.com
api.github.com
codeload.github.com
# Claude
api.anthropic.com
# Package registries (yarn install, the claude-code-action's own `bun install`, corepack's Yarn download)
registry.npmjs.org
registry.yarnpkg.com
repo.yarnpkg.com
